He also discusses PayPal’s turnaround, expansion into financial services and investment in AI. Lores speaks with Haslinda Amin from the sidelines of 'Singapore Fintech Festival 2026'. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: South Korean Watchdog Asks Financial Firms to Report AI Exposure
general.summary: South Korea’s financial watchdog has asked major domestic firms to disclose their exposure to the artificial intelligence industry as worries grow over a sector that’s spurred massive investments and debt financing.

general.title: South Africa Seen Holding Rates for Now as Oil Eases But Could Hike in 2027
general.summary: South Africa’s central bank is set to leave borrowing costs unchanged as oil prices ease and there are few signs that a recent energy-price surge is having a lasting impact on broader inflation.

general.title: Walmart is set to report earnings before the bell. Here's what to expect
general.summary: Walmart is expected to offer color on consumer spending ahead of the holiday season as customers lean into value and convenience.

general.title: Is China Winning the Artificial Intelligence Race That Matters?
general.summary: Its cheaper models, embedded with China’s worldview, are spreading across the developing world and beyond, giving Beijing a long-term edge.

general.title: Anthropic Shares Indicated Up to 24% Higher on Gray Market
general.summary: Anthropic PBC shares are indicated to open higher in gray market trading after the artificial intelligence lab’s upsized $107.3 billion initial public offering and private placement broke SpaceX’s record.

general.title: Wallenberg Investments Takes Minority Stake in AI Firm Algoryx
general.summary: The Wallenberg family’s investment vehicle took a minority stake in Swedish technology company Algoryx AB as it expands its work on artificial intelligence for autonomous machines.

general.title: Lenovo Maintains Revenue Momentum on AI-Fueled Hardware Demand - WSJ
Lenovo Shares Tank After First Operating Loss Since 2017
general.summary: Lenovo Group Ltd. shares slid more than 5% after reporting a far larger-than-anticipated loss for the September quarter, reflecting accounting charges and the mounting cost of PC components.

general.title: India Startup Sells DeepSeek Access While Pursuing Sovereign AI
general.summary: Indian startup Sarvam has begun selling access to DeepSeek and other Chinese AI models, triggering an online backlash over its role as one of the main proponents of the country’s AI independence.
